dateline: BTS's ARIRANG World Tour opens its Buenos Aires run today (Oct 21, 23, 24) at Estadio Único Diego Armando Maradona, La Plata.
heroHeadline: Day 4,878: BTS Opens Buenos Aires Run in La Plata
heroSubtitle: October 21, 2026 is Day 4,878 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. The ARIRANG World Tour's three scheduled La Plata nights (Oct 21, 23, 24) are the group's first South American concerts in nearly a decade. Independent post-show reports for the Santiago dates (Oct 14, 16, 17) have not been located, and a July permit dispute over the venue was reported.
